sources.title: GitHub - QwenLM/Qwen3-TTS: Qwen3-TTS is an open-source series of TTS ...
sources.snippet: Qwen3-TTS is an open-source series of TTS models developed by the Qwen team at Alibaba Cloud, supporting stable, expressive, and streaming speech generation, free-form voice design, and vivid voice cloning.

sources.title: Qwen/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-CustomVoice | vLLM Recipes
sources.snippet: Text-to-speech served via vLLM-Omni with predefined speaker voices and optional style/emotion control, exposed through the OpenAI /v1/audio/speech API. Sibling VoiceDesign and Base (voice-clone) checkpoints share the same serving path.
